D19_D20.pass: Generated memory learner realizes the complete deterministic source language under its declared reset/membership/equivalence oracle assumptions, and varying finite source sizes match an independent full source-state product search.
D19_D20.fail: A finite transcript or bounded test horizon is promoted to all-word equivalence without complete exact source-state closure; unavailable reset/equivalence oracle is silently assumed executable.

D22.pass: Returned minimax destructive-probe cost equals independent finite strategy-tree enumeration for new source tables, including disabled actions and original-source target provenance.
D22.fail: Action filtering, current-state/source-state confusion, unsupported reset, or incomplete witness classes change a purported optimum or make an illegal strategy appear realizable.

F32.pass: Exact hidden-state convolution agrees with full rational state trajectories for fresh matrix dimensions and nonnormal, nilpotent, singular, or decoupled hidden modes, with explicit hidden-initial-state contribution.
F32.fail: A memory formula drops the hidden initial term, assumes an unavailable inverse, or claims all hidden modes are boundary-identifiable.

F34.pass: An independent exact Fourier spectral-convolution oracle recovers the claimed low-mode nonlinear residual on fresh high integer frequencies and distinguishes it from a projected-zero linear evolution.
F34.fail: Projection eliminates the asserted retained triad, divergence-free conditions fail, or an amplitude-scaled numerical example is mistaken for a uniform analytic statement.

fresh_domains: varying-state-count deterministic automata and temporarily disabled actions
finite destructive strategy trees with original-source labels retained
rational nonnormal Jordan and singular hidden linear systems
nonzero hidden initial state with zero external input
integer high-frequency Fourier triads outside fitted examples
independence_boundary: Same model and worker-family audit with a different derivation/implementation, not an external blind referee.
